_about: Taming pen tiers (owner 2026-10-28: each pen only tames certain dinosaurs, mainly by size and how good the dinosaur is). A pen takes a species when real_length_m <= max_length_m AND its value <= max_value. Value = the species' capture_tier (1-5); capture_tier 0 (cannot be netted) counts as 6. Tiers are in rank order; a species needs the first tier it fits. A big tame is shown at its full size and may overhang the fence (never scaled down). # ASSUMPTION: the four tiers, their limits and footprints are defaults, logged in docs/vision/WildLandsMMO_Open_Questions.md.
